text: *Draft 2 (Alternative for clarity):* To better sustain this project, I’m running a small reversible experiment. For the next month, I’m offering a matching fund for all new contributions. If we reach our target, I’ll keep the matching program active to build on growth. If not, I’ll simply revert to our usual funding model. I want to know if de-risking contributions actually increases engagement. It’s a low-cost way to test a hypothesis without burning any bridges.
